library.description: Cooperative coroutine transport plugin for RPC hosts.

blocks.text: 让 RPC 在同一事件循环中的真实协作任务之间运行。
Contract 定义纯协议与接口；Host 拥有会话、目录、provider、调用结算与取消。本包是通过真实 MessageChannel 获取并监管任务的 transport plugin。auth、chunk、batch、probe 等 flow plugin 处理消息流；timeout、retry、pool 等完整 feature 安装在所属 plugin 上。
English · 使用指南
环境需要原生 MessageChannel。任务收到精确的连接句柄，子 Host 通过它连接；任务保持运行直到其 signal 取消。
一个当前直连任务返回 `42`。任务一旦结算，本代真实端口也会结束；不要在构造子 Host 后立即返回。

rows: 创建一个受监管的协作任务
使用该次任务收到的准确 opaque 句柄，不是布尔值
原生注册名与调用命名空间；默认 `coroutine`
完整 timeout、retry 或 pool feature
整代任务停止信号与原监管活性上报

blocks.text: 调用使用 `host.coroutine.*`。一个 Host 可以按不同命名空间安装多个 transport；使用本包无需同时引入其他介质。协作任务不提供进程或 Worker 的隔离，不能抢占同一事件循环上的同步死循环。
spawn 与 connectToParent 恰选一个。句柄只属于当前实际任务，不可复制、伪造或跨代复用。provider 的 context.signal 约束单次业务，与任务 signal 的寿命不同。
调用选项使用完整 `timeout({ ms })`、`retry({ attempts })` 或 `false`。优先级是单次调用、transport feature、链路策略 plugin；没有选中的策略时不自动启用。业务超时不替代原生启动或停止预算。
同载体多任务使用 `coroutinePlugin({ spawn: task, features: [pool({ size: 3 })] })`，pool 来自独立 rpc-plugin-pool。flow plugin 放在 Host 的 `plugins` 中；Devtools 借统一 probe 观察消息，见 Devtools。
自定义部署使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`，只读观察使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`。来源错误保留 TypeError、`rpc.transport.coroutine`、COROUTINE_SOURCE_INVALID；业务、握手和监督错误保留各自 source/code/cause。具体流、取消与替换示例见使用指南。
English · 包概览

Contract 定义纯协议和接口，Host 拥有会话与调用生命周期，Coroutine transport 拥有真实任务/MessageChannel 与原监管接线。flow plugin 处理 auth、chunk、batch、probe；完整 feature 提供 timeout、retry、pool。一个 Host 可以用不同 namespace 安装多个 transport，本指南只使用 `coroutine`。
父子完整示例见 README。应用可将任务声明为 `ICoroutineUserTask`，从当代上下文取得 signal、heartbeat 和 connect：signal 约束任务寿命；heartbeat 报告活性；connect 只交给该次子 Host 的 `connectToParent`。保持任务运行，退出时关闭其子 Host。
`connectToParent` 是 `ICoroutineConnect`，不是 `true`。它关联原任务的真实端口与来源事实，不是可序列化配置。spawn 与 connectToParent 互斥；只有 spawn 配置原生 supervisor。任务共享事件循环和内存，不提供 CPU、权限或进程隔离。
下面保留实际 plugin tuple 的类型。传入的任务需提供 echo 和 values 方法，target 使用当前业务目录中的名称或实例 ID。使用 pooled helper 时另安装 `@migaia/rpc-plugin-pool`。
`host.coroutine.request/notify/stream/group/send/dispatch` 使用统一 namespace 调用语义。notify 只等实际写出；request/send 等业务结果。`notify` 用 `{ targetId }` 指定目标。无目标调用按当前直连集合处理，多个普通直连保持独立结果。
策略顺序为单次 options、transport feature、链路策略 plugin。单次 timeout/retry 只能给完整实例或 false；示例选择 500 ms 超时并关闭本次 retry。没有策略不会隐式新增一个超时或重试循环。supervisor.startupTimeoutMs 属于原生任务启动，与业务 timeout 是不同预算。
流能力从 `host.coroutine.peers[target]` 取得并绑定当前代。消费完或提前退出时 return；这只结束该流，不停止整代任务。重启后重新读取当前目录，旧方法不会自动指向新任务。
调用 signal 与任务 signal 分别由调用 owner 和原监管 owner 处理。处理方应协作读取自己的 context.signal；远端收到序列化后的原因，跨边界按实际 source/code/cause 处理。同步死循环会同时阻塞业务期限和监管回调。
`host.coroutine.members` 提供 list/get/stop/kill/restart/replace/on/watch。目标取实际注册名或当前实例 ID；replace 的 spec 为 `{ task: nextTask }`，由原替换事务处理新旧代。协作停止不是抢占执行，控制返回不应解释为能中断任意同步代码。
`pool(...)` 安装在 transport.features，每个成员是独立真实任务。对外只有逻辑目标 pool，每次操作只选择一个成员。成员管理使用同一 namespace.members；不要把隐藏成员 ID 当成直接业务目标。详见 Pool 指南。
Devtools 是 flow plugin，放在 Host plugins；其 collector 由应用持有。自定义部署使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`，probe 使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`，不读取内部端口或构造第二套握手。
来源错误是带 rpc.transport.coroutine/COROUTINE_SOURCE_INVALID 的 TypeError；调用、握手、监督及清理失败保持原 owner 的错误图。取消业务、结束流、关闭 Host 与终止任务是不同责任。应用结束持有的流与业务后关闭 Host，并让任务响应其原生停止信号。
Run RPC between real cooperative tasks on the same event loop.

Contract defines pure protocol rules and interfaces. Host owns sessions, directories, providers, call settlement, and cancellation. This transport plugin acquires and supervises tasks over real MessageChannels. Flow plugins such as auth, chunk, batch, and probe process messages; complete timeout, retry, and pool features attach to their owning plugin.
中文 · Usage guide
The runtime needs native MessageChannel. Each task receives the exact connection handle for its child Host and stays alive until its task signal is cancelled.
One current direct task returns `42`. Task settlement ends that generation's real ports, so do not return immediately after constructing the child Host.

rows: Use this task's exact opaque handle, not a boolean
Native registration name and call namespace; default `coroutine`
Complete timeout, retry, or pool features
Whole-generation stop signal and native liveness report

blocks.text: Calls live under `host.coroutine.*`. A Host may install transports in distinct namespaces; using this module needs no additional medium. Cooperative tasks provide no process or Worker isolation and cannot preempt a synchronous loop on their shared event loop.

Choose exactly one of spawn and connectToParent. A handle belongs to the actual current task; do not copy, fabricate, or reuse it across generations. Provider context.signal belongs to one business call rather than the task's lifetime.

Call options use complete `timeout({ ms })` and `retry({ attempts })` instances, or `false`. Precedence is per-call, transport feature, then link-policy plugin. No selected policy means no automatic policy. Business timeout does not configure native startup or stop budgets.

For several same-carrier tasks, use `coroutinePlugin({ spawn: task, features: [pool({ size: 3 })] })` with rpc-plugin-pool. Flow plugins go in Host `plugins`; Devtools observes messages through the canonical probe implementation.

Custom deployment uses `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`; readonly observation uses `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`. Invalid sources retain TypeError, `rpc.transport.coroutine`, and COROUTINE_SOURCE_INVALID. Business, handshake, and supervision errors keep their own source/code/cause. See the usage guide for streams, cancellation, and replacement.
中文 · Overview

Contract defines pure protocol rules and interfaces. Host owns sessions and call lifetime; the Coroutine transport owns real tasks/MessageChannels and native supervision integration. Flow plugins provide auth, chunk, batch, and probe; complete features provide timeout, retry, and pool. A Host may install transports in distinct namespaces; this guide uses only `coroutine`.

The README contains a complete parent/child example. Declare an `ICoroutineUserTask` and receive signal, heartbeat, and connect from the current task context. Signal owns task lifetime, heartbeat reports liveness, and connect goes only to this child Host's `connectToParent`. Keep the task alive and close its child Host when exiting.

`connectToParent` takes `ICoroutineConnect`, not `true`. It identifies the original real port and source facts rather than serializable configuration. Spawn and connectToParent are mutually exclusive; only spawn accepts native supervisor options. Tasks share an event loop and memory without CPU, permission, or process isolation.

This retains the actual plugin tuple type. The supplied task must provide echo and values; target is a name or instance ID in the current business directory. Install `@migaia/rpc-plugin-pool` when using the pooled helper.

`host.coroutine.request/notify/stream/group/send/dispatch` uses common namespace semantics. Notify waits only for actual write; request/send waits for business results. Target notify with `{ targetId }`. Untargeted calls use the current direct set, retaining independent outcomes for several ordinary direct targets.

Policy precedence is per-call options, transport features, then link-policy plugin. Per-call timeout/retry takes a complete instance or false. The example selects a 500 ms timeout and disables retry for that call. An absent policy adds no implicit timeout or retry loop. supervisor.startupTimeoutMs is the native task startup budget, separate from business timeout.

Read generation-bound streams through `host.coroutine.peers[target]`. Finish them or call return on early exit; this ends that stream rather than the task generation. Read the current directory again after restart; an old method does not silently point at a new task.

The call owner and native supervisor separately handle call and task signals. Providers should cooperatively inspect context.signal. Remote reasons are serialized; preserve each boundary's actual source/code/cause. A synchronous loop blocks both business deadlines and supervision callbacks.

`host.coroutine.members` provides list/get/stop/kill/restart/replace/on/watch. Select an actual registered name or current instance ID. Replacement spec is `{ task: nextTask }`; the original transaction handles old/new generations. Cooperative stop is not preemption, and a control result does not establish that arbitrary synchronous code can be interrupted.

Install `pool(...)` in transport.features. Every member is a separate real task; only logical target pool enters the directory, and each operation selects one member. Use the same namespace.members for resource administration, without treating private native IDs as direct business targets. See the Pool guide.

Devtools is a flow plugin in Host plugins; its collector remains caller-owned. Custom deployment uses `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`; probes use `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`. Neither requires reading private ports or constructing another handshake.

Invalid sources retain TypeError with rpc.transport.coroutine/COROUTINE_SOURCE_INVALID. Calls, handshakes, supervision, and cleanup keep their respective error graphs. Cancelling work, ending a stream, closing a Host, and ending a task are distinct responsibilities. Finish held work/streams, close the Host, and let the task respond to its original stop signal.

sections.content:
name: Local native registration name, separate from accepted remote identity.
Omitted: the native registration default.
namespace: Unique Host property exposing this transport calls and extensions.
Omitted: the factory namespace.
expose: Feature output paths selected on an ordinary PluginHost; createRpcHost uses its own provide catalog.
Omitted: no ordinary Feature output selected.
report: Receives native background and cleanup failures; operation rejections retain original causes.
report.error: Original background or cleanup failure supplied by the native owner; preserve the error and its cause when sending it to monitoring.
No return value is required. The callback reports the failure; it does not settle an application request or own native cleanup.
Omitted: configured Host reporter, then effective default.
Set an application monitoring sink when cooperative task background and cleanup failures must join your existing incident reports. Omit it to inherit the configured Host reporter.
features: Complete call and supported native feature definitions scoped to this transport. Per-call timeout and retry take instances or false.
Omitted: no optional policy installed by this field.
spawn: Actual task function. Returning settles its generation and closes native ports.
Absent in child mode.
connectToParent: Exact opaque context.connect issued by this task invocation, not copied or reused.
Absent in spawn mode.
supervisor: Original restart, terminalPolicy, startupTimeoutMs, stop, budget and heartbeat policy.
Omitted: original supervisor defaults.
